title: UI Library Part 2 — Slider, ColorPicker, Panel, ScrollArea, Tooltip
description: Create the second batch of reusable UI primitives: Slider (range input with value display), ColorPicker (hex/rgba input with swatch), Panel (collapsible container with header), ScrollArea (custom-styled scrollable container), and Tooltip (hover tooltip with positioning). Update the barrel index.ts to include all new components.
acceptance_criteria: Slider component with min/max/step, value display, Tailwind-styled track/thumb
ColorPicker with hex input, rgba support, visual swatch preview
Panel component with collapsible header, open/closed state, icon support
ScrollArea with custom scrollbar styling for light/dark themes
Tooltip with configurable position (top, bottom, left, right) and delay
All components use Tailwind v4 dark: variants
All components have TypeScript prop interfaces
Updated barrel index.ts exports all new components
completion_summary: Created Slider, ColorPicker, Panel, ScrollArea, Tooltip with full dark mode and TypeScript interfaces
